releaseNotesKm: ការកំណត់ចលនាថ្មី។ តិចបំផុត ធម្មតា ឬ ច្រើន។ កាតស្ថានភាពការងារប្តូរពណ៌យឺតៗ និងកាលវិភាគចូលមកជាលំដាប់។
releaseNotesEn: An animation setting you control, and one gate every animation in the app goes through - including your phone's own reduced-motion switch, which still wins. The work card crossfades between states, the timeline arrives as a sequence, figures count to their new value, and the next event says when it is starting soon.
